items.title: FirstEnergy (FE) Stock Looks Reasonably Priced For Its Earnings Base
items.summary: FirstEnergy has given long term shareholders a solid ride over the past few years, which puts a spotlight on a simple question for anyone looking at the stock today: Is the current share price properly supported by the utility's earnings power?
